# Satyam Patil

> Satyam Patil is the UK-based Founder and Lead Technologist of Rock & Blu Ltd, a software development and IT consultancy delivering websites, web applications, ecommerce, AI products, automation and search-ready digital systems.

## Clear Definitions

- Founder-led digital delivery: a delivery model in which Satyam Patil remains directly responsible for product strategy, user experience, technical architecture, development and launch.
- Technical SEO: work that helps search engines crawl, render, understand and index a website while improving performance, mobile usability and semantic structure.
- Answer engine optimisation (AEO): structuring accurate information as direct, retrievable answers for search assistants and voice systems.
- Generative engine optimisation (GEO): making content clear, well-evidenced and machine-readable so generative AI systems can understand entities, relationships and claims.

## Key Takeaways

- Satyam Patil is a UK-based Founder and Lead Technologist who combines enterprise data-systems experience with hands-on digital product delivery.
- Through Rock & Blu Ltd, Satyam has led seven client engagements: four launched platforms and three active product builds.
- His delivery approach prioritises accessible design, mobile performance, maintainable software and content that customers, search engines and AI systems can understand.

## Client Portfolio

Satyam Patil has led seven client engagements through Rock & Blu Ltd:

- Markou Design London: live digital showroom, project archive and qualified-enquiry platform for bespoke London joinery.
- Orlux Creative: live cinematic website for a creative agency.
- Umu Caffè: live hospitality website and interactive brand experience.
- Abooki: live AI-powered publishing and community reading platform.
- SL London: ecommerce and customer-account platform in active development.
- Anka Academy: education, booking and learning platform in active development.
- AIR: experimental WebGL and particle-physics experience in active development.

## Professional Background

- Founder and Lead Technologist, Rock & Blu Ltd: December 2025 to present.
- Senior Project Engineer and Project Engineer, Wipro: March 2021 to September 2023.
- Wipro work included Anaplan planning models, data integrations, KPI dashboards, workflow automation and user training.
- MSc Computing, University of Essex.

## Evidence

- Seven client engagements: four launched platforms and three active product builds.
- Markou Design London mobile performance improved from 63 to 90.
- Markou Design London First Contentful Paint improved from 4.3 seconds to 0.9 seconds.
- Markou Design London AEO readiness improved from 25 to 100.
- At Wipro, automation reduced manual effort by 40 percent and more than 25 users were trained.
